newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to list options on Discount Auto, Forcenergy.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to list options on Discount Auto, Forcenergy.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said Thursday it would list options on shares of Discount Auto Parts Inc and Forcenergy Inc on October 8.
The PHLX said Discount Auto Parts options will have opening strike prices of 22-1/2, 25 and 30. Initial expirations will be in November, December, February and May.
Forcenergy options will open with strikes of 22-1/2, 25 and 30. Initial expirations will be in November, December, March and June.
Group One Ltd will be the specialist for both options. --Derivatives desk, 312-408-8750/E-mail: derivatives@reuters.com
